sharedSourceFacts: Six distinct panels, each with one dark source dot at left, one vertically oriented convex lens with diagonal hatch strokes and short top/bottom bars, ray segments with rightward arrowheads, one thick vertical image plane at right, and a primed image label.
Left-column sources are labelled A, B, C from top to bottom, with image labels A′, B′, C′. Right-column panels repeat the same corresponding source/image labels.

Left column has two drawn incident ray boundaries per panel. Right column has four drawn incident ray boundaries per panel: outer pair terminates in the stop beside the lens; inner pair traverses the open gap.
Three right-column panels have dark split vertical aperture-stop strokes immediately to the right of their lens; three left-column panels do not have these stop strokes.
No axes, ticks, grid lattice, coordinate values, numerical distances, scale marks, equations, table, natural-object illustration or modern labels are printed in this source figure.

panels.label: а
relationships: A is left of the lens; the two rays diverge to the upper/lower lens edges, then converge to one point on the image plane marked A′.
No aperture stop in this panel.

panels.label: б
relationships: B is visibly nearer its lens horizontally than A in the panel above.
The two transmitted rays remain separated at the image plane, with B′ beside the gap; they do not cross before that plane.
No aperture stop in this panel.

panels.label: в
relationships: C is visibly farther horizontally from its lens than A in the top-left panel.
The two transmitted rays cross before the image plane and reach it at two separated heights, with C′ beside the plane.
No aperture stop in this panel.

panels.label: г
objects: split aperture stop just right of lens
relationships: Outer rays end at the stop strokes; inner rays pass through its central gap.
The transmitted inner pair converges to one point on the image plane at A′.

panels.label: д
objects: split aperture stop just right of lens
relationships: Outer rays end at the stop; the inner transmitted pair remains separated on reaching the image plane.
The visible image-plane separation is smaller than in corresponding panel б; no printed numerical diameter is present.

panels.label: е
objects: split aperture stop just right of lens
relationships: Outer rays end at the stop; the inner transmitted rays cross before the image plane and reach it at two distinct heights.
The visible image-plane separation is smaller than in corresponding panel в; no printed numerical diameter is present.

投影仪 投影仪是用来在屏幕上获得物体放大的实像
的. 物体可以是从后面照明的图片或幻灯片. 投影仪器的结
构简图如图 183 所示. 利用镜头 $O$ 在屏幕上产生幻灯片 $D$ 的
像. 叫做聚光器的透镜组 $K$ 用来把光源发出的光集中到幻灯
片上. 镜头把照亮的幻灯片投影到屏幕上，从幻灯片到屏幕
使镜头靠近或者远离幻灯片，并同时改变投影仪到屏幕
间的距离就可以改变投影仪的放大率.
像透明物体一样，不透明的物体同样也可以用投影仪在
